testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reopen customization after choosing another target without editing ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Tools ribbon tab is selected ✔ And the Part | Tools and Part | Manage custom targets are empty ✔ When the user opens Customize from Tools ✔ Then the ribbon customization target is "Part | Tools" ✔ When the user selects "Part | Manage" as the target ✔ And the user closes customization without editing any commands ✔ And the user opens Customize from Tools again ✔ Then the ribbon customization target is "Part | Tools" ✔ And the target command list is empty ✔ When the user closes customization ✔ Then the Tools ribbon remains visible
